_superseded: The TICKET-WRITER (SIG-TU) role that consumed this config moved out to ellmos-ai/system-auditor on 2026-08-15 (see config/system-auditor.config.example.json there). This file remains only as a record of origin; nothing in this repository reads it anymore.
_comment: Copy this file to ticket-writer.config.json and fill in your own values. Placeholders: <USER> = OS user name, <HOME> = user home directory. The TICKET-WRITER role (prompts/TICKET-WRITER.<lang>.md) reads all paths/commands from here.
_comment_areas: Rotation list for the loop contract: exactly ONE area per run. 'name' is used in reports and ticket ORIGIN lines, 'path' scopes the read-only sweep, 'focus' states what integrity aspects to check.

areas.name: my-pipeline-docs
areas.focus: manifest vs. reality, orphaned files, ownership of directories

areas.name: my-pipeline-software
areas.focus: lock/permissions compliance, stale locks, governance violations

_comment_area_selector_command: Optional external selector (loop contract source 2): a CLI call that prints the next area name, e.g. a taskplan-style selector ('python -m taskplan next --role ticket-writer'). If null, rotation over areas[] applies.
_comment_policy_stores: Binding rules the area is audited against (evidence B). kind: file | command | mcp_tool.
_comment_usmc: USMC adapter for run logging. enabled_probe is executed first; on failure the file fallback (run_reports_dir) applies -- normal operation, not an error.
